latest_release.name: Flecs v4.2.0
latest_release.body:
## Release announcement
https://ajmmertens.medium.com/flecs-4-2-is-out-09435e80fdd1

## Release notes

**This version includes the following improvements:**

- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/0c23311b25137489e6abef6f3860e8eee731a8bb)] Flush stage commands in ecs_fini
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/b5dc21849a552036b11df9b4bba572ebc776047e)] Detect WebAssembly targets other than Emscripten (thanks @andrewgazelka!)
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/119b5ef28686a1893eda6722a00803e8932cbeb7)] Default to Any term for observers without terms
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/9ef0665b9ed9333b32db2a4f2476b1ef24fb758f)] Rename (OnInstantiate, Override) trait to (OnInstantiate, Copy)
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/4176192ecd8b22ed151a599df8899da9dfad02ec)] Add ecs_ref_from_ptr()
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/961e8eec298fe4eb99e88382d0ceb3cb2d0adab9)] Lock tables for OnAdd/OnRemove hooks and observers
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/75fa09fa2f0874cb26bda8626ffdc0bce41a4f9e)] Only allow DontFragment With targets on DontFragment components
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/e2cbd50be30e22cb25f1eee95ae415e3768aab69)] Reduce overhead of disabling entities
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/e201c607f86c3f2d3b2009fdbb3ba682c2b8c51d)] Optimize performance and memory usage of table graph storage
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/e0280d488f077274c29b95c2f92a8fe1c3386466)] Allow changing components of instantiated prefab by clearing stale IsA edges
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/ddc33b610dbff2834a8f04b26a47b3a294137551)] Do not silence warnings in user code
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/eba64e46300af562af8a6864def68ff90ad2c208)] Add Sparse and DontFragment support to ecs_each_id
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/2919586c8b4f8cc71c63e5ac64f25fefb4d7fc9f)] Return empty iterator from ecs_children for Wildcard and Any parents
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/4f12f78333fa97a3d5005ab0b43faabad9c04419)] Rename ecs_is_deferred to ecs_is_stage
- [[script](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/74216a6706dc76358ca9491ca37a837da6c54d26)] Warn when a script inherits from Prefab instead of declaring a prefab
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/2ea40dd95c6940e7432408843c7f5ed03170bd90)] Emit ChildOf events for entities created with ecs_new_w_parent
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/2c517a7705218b9e06d7a0e6a70f155921e14bad)] Remove implicit defer mode from core
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/9df3fc1ff79cf52c0225bf3bb67857b3655c36f7)] Implement component inheritance as storage feature
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/6259d63789417069ec466ce0394af6a3af220416)] Allow setting cmp/equals hooks on in-use components
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/ca4b5e9247b9c149a2f0d71dad34a12b680c15be)] Copy inherited DontFragment components to instantiated prefab children that have no IsA relationship with the prefab child
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/0e07b835a2f5cb2c6b191b1d12125b4dc53e8306)] Events only propagate down a subtree when an observer with an up term exists for the id
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/7b15e5c10b63b07a1de9796c12972eac6c7095bf)] Observers skip the query engine for tables that cannot match by type and resolve single up(IsA) terms through the base table
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/91ac4d5c85d6ff52382cfd2e7f74e4c7bcb073cd)] Skip observer maps that hold only up notify observers when forwarding events
- [[core](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/commit/40961229a40fba65949450a99784a422aa7aebbf)] Create named childr
